name: application-button-groups
title: Button Groups
description: Clusters of related action buttons presented as a single visual unit for toolbars, segmented controls, and view toggles.
useWhen: Two to five closely related actions belong together and should feel like a single control.
Offering mutually exclusive view or filter options such as List / Grid / Map.
Building toolbars where grouped icon buttons need to appear as a contiguous control strip.
avoidWhen: Actions are unrelated — use separate buttons with spacing instead.
There are more than five options — use a select or dropdown to avoid a crowded toolbar.
The options represent navigation destinations rather than actions on the current view.
responsiveBehavior: Groups stack vertically or collapse to icon-only on small viewports. Ensure each button remains easily tappable at mobile sizes.
accessibility: Wrap mutually exclusive toggle groups in a <div role="group"> with an aria-label that names the group.
The active button in a toggle group should use aria-pressed="true" or aria-selected="true".
Icon-only buttons must carry an aria-label describing the specific action.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Three bordered buttons joined into a single strip for a set of related primary actions.
accessibility: Group needs aria-label or aria-labelledby on the wrapper to name the set of actions.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Bordered related-action button strip adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark border and text colors maintain readable contrast.

variants.title: Icons
variants.description: Icon-only button strip for compact toolbar controls where text labels would consume too much space.
accessibility: Each icon button must have an aria-label describing the specific action it triggers.

variants.title: Icons (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-only toolbar strip adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Each icon button must have an aria-label; icon contrast on dark backgrounds must meet WCAG AA.

variants.title: Main and secondary
variants.description: A visually heavier primary button paired with lighter secondary actions in a contiguous group to communicate hierarchy.
accessibility: Visual weight difference is supplementary — use correct button types for semantic meaning.

variants.title: Main and secondary (Dark)
variants.description: Primary and secondary button hierarchy group adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Dark button colors must preserve sufficient contrast between primary and secondary states.

variants.title: Layouts
variants.description: Multiple button group arrangements — horizontal and vertical — shown side by side as a layout reference.
accessibility: Each group needs its own aria-label to distinguish it from sibling groups.

variants.title: Layouts (Dark)
variants.description: Horizontal and vertical button group layout reference adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Each group needs its own aria-label to distinguish it from sibling groups.

variants.title: Layouts without space
variants.description: Tightly connected button groups with no gap between items, creating a flush segmented-control appearance.
accessibility: Shared borders are decorative; individual button focus rings must remain clearly visible.

variants.title: Layouts without space (Dark)
variants.description: Flush segmented button groups adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Individual button focus rings must remain clearly visible against dark backgrounds.
